description: Verify that the Type 2 entry Index First Option Run of the SubscribeAck/Nack is first option of the first run (= 0)
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: Type 2 entry Index First Option Run must equal first option of the first run (= 0). The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying SubscribeAck/Nack, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a SubscribeAck/Nack (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured SubscribeAck/Nack's Type 2 entry Index First Option Run == first option of the first run (= 0)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Type 2 entry Index First Option Run on the wire equals first option of the first run (= 0).

[Fail condition]
• Fail_index_first — Entry IndexFirstOptionRun nonzero
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying SubscribeAck/Nack within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted Type 2 entry Index First Option Run == first option of the first run (= 0) — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SubscribeAck/Nack within listen window
